Title: European Union vehicle type
Description: The type of vehicle specified in eForms.

Title: European Union Clean Vehicle Directive vehicle category
Description: The category of vehicle falling within the scope of the EU Clean Vehicles Directive 2009/33/EC.

Title: European Union Clean Vehicle Directive contract type
Description: The category of contract according to the EU Clean Vehicles Directive 2009/33/EC.

Title: Classification of the Functions of Government
Description: A standard classifying the purposes of government activities, developed by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development and published by the United Nations Statistical Division.

Title: EU Type of contracting authority (TED schema)
Description: The types of contracting authority within the domain of public procurement according to the legislation of the European Parliament. This scheme's codes match those in TED schema.

Title: EU Main activity of contracting entity (TED schema)
Description: The main activity of the contracting entity within the domain of public procurement according to the legislation of the European Parliament. This scheme's codes match those in TED schema.

Title: EU Buyer contracting entity type (eForms)
Description: Whether or not the buyer is a contracting entity within the domain of public procurement according to the legislation of the European Parliament.

Title: EU Main activity authority list (eForms)
Description: The main activity of the contracting entity within the domain of public procurement according to the legislation of the European Parliament. This scheme's codes match those in eForms.

Title: EU Buyer legal type (eForms)
Description: The type of the procuring authority within the domain of public procurement according to the legislation of the European Parliament. This scheme's codes match those in eForms.

Title: European Union direct award justification (TED schema)
Description: Justification for using a procedure which allows awarding contracts directly without the requirement of publishing a call for competition in the Official Journal of the European Union. This scheme's codes match those in the TED schema.

Title: European Union direct award justification (eForms)
Description: Justification for using a procedure which allows awarding contracts directly without the requirement of publishing a call for competition in the Official Journal of the European Union. This scheme's codes match those in eForms.

Title: EC Public passenger transport services covered
Description: A classification of the services covered by the award of contracts for public passenger transport services according to Regulation 1370/2007 of the European Parliament.
